cells.rationale: The small recent reference class is mildly favorable: two of the last three first prints exceeded 194,000, and recent claims have generally clustered around 194,000–200,000. The roughly 196,000 consensus and typical week-to-week variation put the estimate above 50%, although the latest print was exactly at the threshold and the low-fire trend limits confidence. Late-October seasonality, layoffs, or an economic shock could move the first estimate materially in either direction.

note: Judge panel member forecasting from Claude's evidence brief before each cutoff; scored as a separate method.
